Name: Propaganda
Description: The dissemination of information—biased or misleading—to promote a political cause or point of view.

Name: Disinformation
Description: Deliberately creating and spreading false information to deceive and harm target audiences.

Name: Misinformation
Description: Spreading false information without the intent to deceive, often due to error or lack of verification.

Name: Narrative Manipulation
Description: The strategic framing or reframing of events to control how target audiences perceive reality.

Name: Psychological Operations
Description: Operations aimed at influencing the emotions, motives, objective reasoning, and behavior of foreign governments, organizations, and individuals.

Name: Deepfake Distribution
Description: The use of AI-generated audio/video to create convincing, fraudulent content of real individuals.

Name: Censorship
Description: The suppression of speech, public communication, or other information on the basis that such material is considered objectionable, harmful, or sensitive.

Name: Information Suppression
Description: Deliberately withholding or burying specific information to prevent it from reaching the target population.

Name: Influence Campaign
Description: A coordinated effort to influence the opinions, attitudes, or behavior of a target audience over time.

Name: Rumor Propagation
Description: The systematic spreading of unverified information to sow discord, fear, or uncertainty.

Name: Character Assassination
Description: Deliberate smearing of political opponents, leaders, or institutions to erode trust.

Name: Demoralization
Description: Systematically belittling a nation's achievements, culture, or history to induce hopelessness.

Name: Educational Co-optation
Description: Using scholarships, academic funding, or university partnerships to build foreign influence networks.

Name: Cyber Intrusion
Description: Unauthorized access to a computer system or network to steal, alter, or damage data.

Name: Malware Deployment
Description: The use of malicious software to compromise, control, or destroy computer systems.

Name: Data Exfiltration
Description: The unauthorized transfer of data from a computer or other device.

Name: Denial of Service
Description: An attempt to make a machine or network resource unavailable to its intended users.

Name: Credential Theft
Description: Stealing usernames and passwords to gain unauthorized access to accounts or systems.

Name: Supply Chain Compromise
Description: Inserting malicious code into products or software during the production/distribution process.

Name: Data Harvesting & Microtargeting
Description: Mass collection of user data specifically to weaponize cognitive campaigns through highly personalized messaging.

Name: Algorithmic Manipulation
Description: Exploiting search engines or social media algorithms to bury positive information or amplify negative sentiment.

Name: Economic Sanctions
Description: Commercial and financial penalties applied by one or more countries against a targeted self-governing state, group, or individual.

Name: Market Manipulation
Description: Artificially inflating or deflating the price of a security or otherwise influencing the behavior of the market for personal gain or strategic disruption.

Name: Currency Manipulation
Description: Intentional interference in the foreign exchange market to gain an unfair competitive advantage or cause economic destabilization.

Name: Resource Denial
Description: Preventing access to critical resources like fuel, water, or raw materials.

Name: Investment Influence
Description: Using foreign investment (FDI) as a means to gain political or economic leverage over a target government.

Name: Trade Restriction
Description: Limiting the import or export of goods to exert political or economic pressure.

Name: Strategic Asset Acquisition
Description: Covert or overt purchase of real estate, ports, or utilities by foreign actors for strategic leverage rather than commercial gain.

Name: Subversion Funding
Description: Providing financial support to domestic destabilizing organizations, violent groups, or opposition networks.

Name: Policy Sabotage
Description: Exploiting or intentionally inducing a lack of executive economic policies or regulatory failure to weaken the target state.

Name: Diplomatic Pressure
Description: Using official state channels to coerce, threaten, or isolate a target state.

Name: Election Interference
Description: Coordinated efforts to alter the outcome of an electoral process.

Name: Institutional Capture
Description: Infiltrating or corrupting key government institutions to align them with foreign interests.

Name: Legal Manipulation
Description: Using national or international laws (lawfare) as a tool to harass, punish, or restrict target actors.

Name: Crisis Exploitation
Description: Weaponizing an existing, unrelated domestic crisis to push a hostile agenda.

Name: International Forum Manipulation
Description: Using international bodies (e.g., UN) to legally or diplomatically isolate the target.

Name: Border Provocation
Description: Utilizing border disputes to manufacture tension without formal kinetic strikes.

Name: Kinetic Strike
Description: Direct military attack, ranging from tactical raids to large-scale bombardment.

Name: Sabotage
Description: Deliberate destruction, damage, or obstruction of assets, systems, or infrastructure.

Name: Espionage
Description: Clandestine collection of sensitive information.

Name: Force Projection
Description: The ability to project military force over a distance to influence events, intimidate, or strike.

Name: Coercive Deployment
Description: Positioning military forces to intimidate or compel a target into specific political behaviors.

Name: Undeclared Gray-Zone Action
Description: Military or paramilitary actions intentionally kept below the threshold of formal war declarations.

Name: Proxy Warfare Support
Description: Arming, training, or advising non-state militias to engage the target militarily.

Name: Social Polarization
Description: Systematically intensifying divisions within a society based on ideology, race, religion, or class.

Name: Identity Manipulation
Description: Exploiting cultural, ethnic, or historical identity markers to create internal friction.

Name: Cultural Influence
Description: The systematic promotion of foreign values, arts, or lifestyle to erode domestic cultural integrity.

Name: Protest Mobilization
Description: Coordinating and inciting large-scale public demonstrations to challenge governance.

Name: Migration Pressure
Description: Orchestrating or forcing refugee movement to overwhelm a target's social and economic resources.

Name: Violence & Riot Incitement
Description: Actively pushing peaceful social movements into physical violence or riots.

Name: Weaponized Migration
Description: Using migration flows as a deliberate instrument of statecraft to destabilize a target country.

Name: Extremist Radicalization
Description: Actively grooming fringe elements of society into domestic terrorist or subversive factions.
